competitors.name: LDWW / grocery AI platforms
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported LDWW survey findings that 70% of U.S. shoppers already use AI to shop for products and services, 71% expect to use it more, and 30% have used AI to purchase products or services. The signal for Real Dough is that brand facts, claims and product availability need to be legible to AI-assisted shopping paths, not only to in-store shoppers.

competitors.name: IFIC / packaged food brands
competitors.action: Food Business News reported that IFIC's 2026 Food & Health Survey found consumer familiarity with ultra-processed foods rose to 52%, up from 44% last year and 32% two years ago. Ingredient lists and Nutrition Facts panels are the top ways shoppers judge whether a food is ultra-processed, increasing pressure on packaged-food brands to make processing and ingredient cues clear.

competitors.name: FGF Brands / Metro Première Moisson
competitors.action: Food Business News reported that FGF Brands plans to acquire Metro's Première Moisson wholesale bakery for C$90 million while Metro keeps the brand, 25 Quebec retail bakeries and in-store artisanal production. FGF will bake and distribute Première Moisson products for retail stores, using its scale across breads, flatbreads, pizza crusts, sourdough and other bakery formats.

trends.magnitude: 70% of U.S. shoppers already use AI to shop; 71% expect to increase use
trends.context: AI tools are becoming part of product discovery and decision-making, so item data, claims and source citations matter more for grocery brands.

trends.magnitude: 52% familiar with ultra-processed food, up from 44% last year and 32% two years ago
trends.context: Shoppers are using ingredient lists and nutrition panels to define processing for themselves, which favors clear ingredient and process narratives over vague better-for-you language.

trends.magnitude: C$90 million planned sale of Première Moisson wholesale bakery to FGF Brands
trends.context: Retailers and bakery manufacturers are separating artisan brand equity from scaled manufacturing, including in sourdough, flatbread and pizza-crust-adjacent formats.
